title: task_queue row
description: One row per queued work item in state/ssot/task_queue.jsonl. ANY substrate worker (Codex, Antigravity, $0 mesh, ChatGPT cloud, Claude) pulls from this file. Append-only. A worker NEVER edits a queue row; it writes a claim and later a result. This is one of exactly TWO schemas the factory adds - see contracts/mape_k_schedule_adapter.v0_1.md.

task_id.description: kebab-case, globally unique. The join key to task_results.jsonl.

queued_by.description: Callsign of the queuer. A task with no owner is not a task.

objective.description: ONE bounded task. If it needs a conjunction, it is two tasks.

capabilities_required.description: A worker pulls only tasks whose capabilities are a SUBSET of its declared capabilities. This is the whole routing rule.

effect_ceiling.description: T2 requires a signed campaign authorization. A worker MUST refuse a task whose ceiling exceeds its own.

acceptance_test.description: REQUIRED and MUST be written BEFORE the task is worked (Ratatoskr R3). A checkable condition a non-producer can evaluate. 'Looks good' is not an acceptance test.

status.description: Advisory projection only. AUTHORITY is the append-only tail: the latest claim/result row for this task_id wins. Never rewrite a queue row to change status.

expires_utc.description: claimed_utc + timebox_minutes + grace. On expiry the task is pullable again. This is the ONLY retry mechanism in v0.

attempts.description: 3 attempts then DEADLETTER. A task that has failed 3 times is a spec problem, not a worker problem.

consumer.description: Who ACCEPTS the result. Without a named consumer the output is inventory (Ratatoskr R1). Defaults to the queuer.

depends_on.description: task_ids that must be DONE first.
